About the author

Stories to read together.

K.R. writes funny, heartfelt stories for kids — Jewish holiday adventures, cozy bedtime books and stories about being thankful. The kind you read together and laugh about at the table.

Books · Graphic novel, ages 7–12

Spin of Light: The Lichter Twins and the Miracle of Chanukah

A Chanukah graphic novel for ages 7–12.

Twins Yehudah and Yehudis find Zaidy's old dreidel and spin their way back to ancient Modiin, where they see the Maccabees and the miracle of the oil up close. A funny, heartfelt Chanukah graphic novel for ages 7–12, with a goat named Kugel along for the ride.

Picture books · Ages 3–8

Bedtime and holiday picture books

Glimmer, the Night Light Who Was Afraid of the Dark

A little night light who is scared of the dark learns to be brave. A cozy bedtime story.

Kindle edition Paperback Apple Books Barnes & Noble More stores

Hazel's Thankful Basket

Hazel the squirrel shares her acorns with hungry friends and finds out what being thankful really means. A sweet Thanksgiving story.

Kindle edition Paperback

Shimmy Lights Up Maple Street

Shimmy, a boy with Down syndrome, invites one more neighbor each night of Chanukah to see the menorah, until the whole street comes outside. A warm Chanukah story about small lights and big hearts.

Kindle edition Paperback

Mémé's Festival of the Daughters

On the sixth night of Chanukah, two cousins have a fight. Then Mémé arrives with a secret from her childhood in Tunisia: tonight is the Festival of the Daughters. A warm Chanukah story about family and making peace.

Kindle edition Paperback

The Helper Candle

New! In review at Amazon, coming in about 72 hours (Kindle and paperback). Every Chanukah night, the family counts the lights, but nobody ever counts the shamash, the little helper candle. A warm, gentle Chanukah story about how helping others shine is its own way to shine.

Spin of Light Chanukah Activity Book

Puzzles, mazes and coloring fun with the Lichter twins. A printable activity book for ages 5–10.
